text: Respect should be earned by actions, and not acquired by years.
author: Frank Wright

archive.text: I will prepare and some day my chance will come.
archive.author: Abraham Lincoln

archive.text: When you look at the stars and the galaxy, you feel that you are not just from any particular piece of land, but from the solar system.
archive.author: Kalpana Chawla

archive.text: The man who does not read has no advantage over the man who cannot read.
archive.author: Mark Twain

archive.text: Do not grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form.
archive.author: Rumi

archive.text: You can be sure of succeeding in your attacks if you only attack places which are undefended.
archive.author: Sun Tzu

archive.text: What I am looking for is not out there, it is in me.
archive.author: Helen Keller

archive.text: What is hell? I maintain that it is the suffering of being unable to love.
archive.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
